text:
Lina: FYI seeing a sudden spike hitting /v1/embeddings (~25k rps) starting ~4m ago, mostly from CN/RU geo. 429s and queuing at edge. CPU on proxy nodes up 80%.
Ajay: on it — any pattern on ASNs or user agents?
Lina: quick grep shows many requests from a handful of ASNs (AS12345, AS67890). UA mostly `python-requests/2.x` and some weird `curl/7.*` variants.
Kevin: recommend soft throttle first (429-based rate limit) on embeddings route. Hard block risks false positives for customers behind shared proxies.
Maggie: status page? CS needs a short note if customers will see degraded throughput.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0456. Assigned -> eng-sre, ops-oncall.
Ajay: rolling a temporary WAF rule to restrict rate per IP and add geo scoring. Proposed rule snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "temp-geo-throttle-embeddings",
  "match": { "path": "/v1/embeddings" },
  "actions": [
    { "type": "rate_limit", "requests_per_minute": 120, "granularity": "ip" },
    { "type": "score", "conditions": [{"ip.geoip.country": ["CN","RU"]}, {"asn": [12345,67890]}], "score": 80 },
    { "type": "block_if_score_above", "threshold": 70 }
  ]
}
```
Kevin: ok for a short window. Make sure rule is logged and reversible. Add `dry_run=false` once we confirm efficacy.
Lina: deploying rule now (temp-geo-throttle-embeddings) -> pushing to edge-1/2/3.
Ajay: keep an eye on false positives: list of recent 200 blocked IPs? We should validate against our known customer IPs.
ops-bot: waf-rule-deploy started: temp-geo-throttle-embeddings by Ajay at 1851234580
Lina: initial metrics: 60% reduction in offending requests, 429s down 40% at edge. Latency stable.
Kevin: good. Next: update per-route rate limits in the config: `/v1/embeddings` default -> 100r/m per IP, burst 200. Command: `infractl rate-limit set --route /v1/embeddings --rpm 100 --burst 200 --scope ip`
Maggie: CS note drafted: "We’re mitigating a regionally concentrated traffic surge affecting embeddings throughput. Some requests may receive 429s. We'll update shortly." Approving to publish to status page?
Lina: publish. Add note: customers behind corporate proxies may see 429s and we’re allowing list for verified ASNs.
Ajay: quick audit check — who can change WAF rules right now? We should record approvals. Suggest requiring two approvers for production WAF changes until postmortem. Also ensure audit logs are immutable and exported to long-term storage.
Kevin: +1. We currently write audit logs to S3 with server-side encryption using KMS CMK `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/xxxx`. Ensure key policy allows only ops-admin and audit-reader roles. Also enable Object Lock (governance) for the bucket for 30d.
Maggie: action item added to incident: verify RBAC for WAF changes and enable 2-approver flow (owner: Ajay).
Lina: ops-bot reports no customer-facing alerts in the last 10m aside from expected 429s.
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert suppressed by Lina at 1851234689 (reason: mitigation in progress)
Ajay: request list of ASNs seen; also file abuse reports with upstream transits for AS12345/AS67890.
Kevin: can we apply a targeted ASN block at edge? That’s less collateral than geo-block. Ops: `edgectl asn-block add 12345 --route /v1/embeddings --duration 2h`
Lina: applied ASN block 12345 & 67890; monitoring.
Maggie: marquee customers flagged as impacted (2 customers). CS engaging them directly with a personalized note.
Ajay: after we stabilize, export blocked request samples to S3 for the forensics team; ensure the export is encrypted with KMS CMK and audit logged.
Kevin: reminder — any exported logs containing PII must be scrubbed. We should run the scrubber job before long-term retention.
Lina: metrics look stable now, requests down to baseline, 429s normalizing. Suggest keep rules for 1 hour then revert to baseline rates and monitor.
Maggie: status page updated: resolved -> mitigation in place, monitoring.
ops-bot: waf-rule-deploy finished: temp-geo-throttle-embeddings success at 1851234750
Ajay: agreed on 1 hour hold. After revert, we’ll run post-incident:
- verify WAF rule history and RBAC changes (owner: Ajay)
- ensure audit logs exported and retention policy applied (owner: Kevin)
- add region-aware rate-limits to runbook and permanent ASN denylist process (owner: Lina)
- CS follow-ups and customer communications summary (owner: Maggie)
Kevin: also add a KMS rotation review for the CMK used to encrypt exports; confirm key policies don't grant broad roles.
Lina: reopening runbook item: ensure every WAF change has a recorded approver field.
Maggie: postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Include timeline, customer impact, and cost analysis.
Lina: closing thread here — will update INC ticket with metrics and links to logs once exports complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
